desc: m1n1 proxy NVMe Flush probe (scripts/t6040-nvme-flush-probe.py): identity gate, nvme_init, read LBA0, flush nsid 1 then 0xFFFFFFFF, re-read LBA0 (must be identical), shutdown. No data write path: the proxy has no NVMe write opcode; Flush carries no data. Decides the Linux flush fix after 211 write1 BAD_CMD (evidence/2026-10-25-t6040-211-write1-flush-badcmd.md): nsid1 OK -> TCB-level fix in apple.c (zeroed TCB, m1n1 encoding); only broadcast OK -> NSID fix; both fail -> write-through plan B with hard-reset verify. Runs on the enrolled rollback proxy, no boot.
author: claude

hashes.target: enrolled rollback proxy m1n1 (no boot, no chainload)
